experiment-timeout.summary: Three in-budget requests completed and the over-deadline request was cancelled.
observations: AbortSignal cancelled the over-deadline provider call.
Latency values are local wall-clock measurements against deterministic timers.

experiment-retry.summary: Bounded retries recovered temporary 429/500 failures and did not retry permanent failures.
observations: Backoff timing is virtual and deterministic; no provider traffic occurred.
Amplification is provider calls divided by one logical task.

experiment-schema.summary: Parsing, structural validity, and domain validity were measured independently.
observations: Schema-valid output can still fail confidence or citation requirements.

experiment-fallback.summary: Fallback improved completion for retryable failures without masking authentication failures.
observations: Cost units are synthetic metadata, not currency or provider pricing.

experiment-load.summary: A capacity-limited fake provider exposed throughput, tail latency, errors, and rate limiting under bursts.
observations: Results measure local deterministic fault injection and are not provider benchmarks.
